title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 8:5-13
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 8:5-13</bp-cite>. Note: this is not a BibleProject translation. It is a very literal translation of the SBL Greek New Testament, © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software (CC BY 4.0), with added highlights and structure. Beta: it may still change.
usx:
<usx version="2.6" status="translated">
  <para>
    <group type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> Now when he <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="tan">entered into Kapharnaoum</char>,
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        a centurion
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise" word-lang="greek" word-original="προσῆλθεν">approached</char> him,
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">pleading with</char> him <verse number="6" /> and saying,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master</char>, my <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="παῖς" word-gloss="son / servant">boy</char> <char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">has been thrown down</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-6-thrown"><char style="xt">Matthew 9:2</char></note> in the house,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        paralyzed, terribly tormented.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="7" /> And he said to him,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan" word-lang="greek" word-original="Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν">I, coming</char>, will heal him?”<note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-7-question"><char style="xt">Matthew 3:14</char></note>
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="8" /> And responding, the centurion said,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master</char>, <char style="bd">I am not worthy</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-8-worthy"><char style="xt">Matthew 3:11</char></note> that you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan" word-lang="greek" word-original="εἰσ-έλθῃς" word-gloss="into-come">come in</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπὸ">under</char> my roof,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        but only speak with a word,
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        and my <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="παῖς" word-gloss="son / servant">boy</char> <char style="bd" mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἰαθήσεται">will be healed</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-8-healed"><char style="xt">Matthew 15:28</char></note>.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary" indent="1">
        <group>
          <verse number="9" /> For I too am a man <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπὸ">under</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="orange">authority</char>,
        </group>
        <group>
          having soldiers <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="ὑπʼ">under</char> me,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and I say to this one, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">Go</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">goes</char>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and to another, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">Come</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">comes</char>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and to my slave, ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">Do this</char>!’ and he <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">does</char>.”
        </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="secondary" indent="1">
        <group>
          <verse number="10" /> Now hearing, Iesous was amazed
        </group>
        <group>
          and said to the ones <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">following</char>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char style="bd">Truly I say to you</char><note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-10-truly"><char style="xt">Matthew 11:11</char></note>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          with no one in Israel have I found such <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">trust</char>.
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1">
          <verse number="11" /> Now I say to you that many from the east and west will come
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          and recline <char style="add">at table</char> with Abra’am and Isaak and Iakob
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          in the kingdom of the skies;
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="1">
          <verse number="12" /> but the sons of the kingdom <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">will be thrown out</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          into the outer darkness;
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          there will be <char style="bd">crying and grinding of teeth</char>.”<note style="x" caller="+" xref="matthew-8-12-teeth"><char style="xt">Matthew 13:42</char></note>
        </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> And Iesous said to the centurion,
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">Go</char>!
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        As you <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">trusted</char>, may it be done for you.”
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        And the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue" word-lang="greek" word-original="παῖς" word-gloss="son / servant">boy</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green" word-lang="greek" word-original="ἰάθη">was healed</char> in that hour.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
